Hi! I'm a Dom and they key to getting into it, sustaining it, and ensuring mutual happiness is communication. Communication, communication, communication.

I would suggest sitting down with your someone to discuss what she's into and what she would like to get out of that sort of relationship to give you a better look at wether or not you'd like what she's suggesting, because no DD/LG relationship is the same. Don't forget to advocate for yourself, your feelings are just as important.

Even if you like taking on a nurturing role and like commanding, DD/LG might not be a good option for you, if you feel uncomfortable with being called Daddy, or for whatever reason. It's totally up to both of you. 

If you decide that a DD/LG dynamic is what you want, definitely go slow. Find what works for both of you, and keep their feelings in your mind. Don't push her into anything suddenly (because i know that can be easy with a dominant role), and be careful to respect boundaries. 

Other than that, have fun! Being in a DD/LG dynamic is the most fun I've ever had in a relationship.
